title: Yellow Silky Croatian Onion Stew
description: A fresh and silky Croatian dish featuring chopped onion, perfect for a sick day, made with brine-wet and keto-friendly ingredients. This stew is a comforting and healthy option for any time of the year.
instructions: In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew until it is smooth and silky.
Stir in the heavy cream and continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
